description.value:
You lay eyes on a creature within range and channel a surge of restorative energy into it, returning 70 hit points and curing blindness, deafness, and any diseases afflicting it. Droids and constructs gain no benefit.

Cast with a 7th-level slot or higher, the hit points restored increase by 10 for each slot level above 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 6
